# Question 2

#Prequestion Setup
```{r}
sample_means <- vector("numeric", 10000)
```

```{r}
length(sample_means)
```


```{r}
for (i in 1:10000) {sample_means[i] <- mean(rexp(5, rate = 1))}
```

```{r}
head(sample_means)
```
```{r}
means_df <- data.frame(sample_means)
```


```{r}
ggplot(means_df, aes(x = sample_means)) + geom_histogram(bins = 30) + 
  labs(title = "Distribution",
    x = "Sample Mean",
    y = "Frequency")
```
# The histogram is skewed to the right.

#Question 2
#2A) 

```{r}
sample_means_map <- map_dbl(1:10000, function(i) {mean(rexp(5, rate = 1))})
```

```{r}
map_df <- data.frame(sample_means_map)

ggplot(map_df, aes(x = sample_means_map)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution Using map_dbl()",
    x = "Sample Mean",
    y = "Frequency"
  )
```


#2B)

```{r}
replicate(10000, mean(rexp(5, rate = 1)))
```
#2C)

```{r}
sample_sizes <- c(5, 10, 20)
```

```{r}
for (n in sample_sizes) {
  
  sample_means <- vector("numeric", 10000)
  
  for (i in 1:10000) {
    sample_means[i] <- mean(rexp(n, rate = 1))
  }
  
  means_df <- data.frame(sample_means)
  
  p <- ggplot(means_df, aes(x = sample_means)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Sample Size =", n),
      x = "Sample Mean",
      y = "Frequency"
    )
  
  print(p)
}
```

```{r}
dates <- seq.Date(
  from = as.Date("2015-01-01"),
  to = as.Date("2025-12-31"),
  by = "2 months"
)
```

```{r}
dates
```

```{r}
year(dates)
quarter(dates)
isoweek(dates)
```
```{r}
date_table <- data.frame(
  date = dates,
  year = year(dates),
  quarter = quarter(dates),
  iso_week = isoweek(dates)
)

date_table
```

# Question 5

```{r}
sample_dates <- c("2018-03-15", "2020-07-20", "2023-01-10", "2025-09-05")

sample_dates <- ymd(sample_dates)
```

```{r}
start_dates <- head(sample_dates, -1)
end_dates <- tail(sample_dates, -1)
```

```{r}
start_dates
end_dates
```
```{r}
date_intervals <- interval(start_dates, end_dates)
```

```{r}
months_difference <- time_length(date_intervals, "month")
weeks_difference <- time_length(date_intervals, "week")
```

```{r}
date_differences <- data.frame(start_date = start_dates, end_date = end_dates,months =months_difference,weeks = weeks_difference)

date_differences
```
# Question 6

```{r}
date_strings <- list(
  "2023-06-10",
  "2022/12/25",
  "15-Aug-2021",
  "InvalidDate"
)
```

```{r}
safe_date <- possibly(
  function(x) {
    as.Date(parse_date_time(x, orders = c("ymd", "d-b-Y")))
  },
  otherwise = as.Date(NA)
)
```

```{r}
parsed_dates <- map(date_strings, safe_date)
```

```{r}
parsed_dates
```
```{r}
month_names <- map(parsed_dates, ~ month(.x, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE))

month_names
```
